en.title: Persona Series: Every Game and Spin-Off in Order for Newcomers
en.summary: The beloved Persona RPG series is expanding with new announcements, leaving many wondering where to begin. From its Shin Megami Tensei roots to its multimedia empire, we break down every title.
en.body:
The **Persona** series, which began as a spin-off of **Shin Megami Tensei**, has blossomed into a global phenomenon. Its unique blend of stylish JRPG combat and deep social simulation has captivated millions, spanning anime, manga, stage plays, and more. With recent announcements hinting at **Persona 4 Revival** and the highly anticipated **Persona 6**, now is the perfect time for both long-time fans and curious newcomers to navigate the series' extensive library.

From its humble beginnings in 1996 with **Revelations: Persona**, the franchise has steadily built a universe where players dive into a hidden world using their Personas, manifestations of their psyche. The narrative often revolves around high school students who must balance their everyday lives with extraordinary battles against supernatural threats. The series is renowned for its compelling characters, intricate storylines, and iconic soundtracks, making it a cornerstone of modern RPGs.

## Charting the Persona Journey

The **Persona** series boasts a total of 21 games, including mainline entries, enhanced versions, and various spin-offs. While playing in chronological order offers a cohesive narrative experience, release order is often recommended for understanding the series' development and how mechanics evolved. For those looking to jump in, **Persona 5 Royal** is frequently cited as an excellent entry point due to its modern presentation and engaging story, though **Persona 4 Golden** also remains a strong contender for its beloved characters and atmosphere. The recent remake, **Persona 3 Reload**, offers a fantastic way to experience the game that truly cemented **Persona**'s identity, with updated visuals and gameplay.

## A Franchise That Keeps on Giving

The sheer volume of **Persona** titles, from rhythm games like **Persona 4: Dancing All Night** to tactical RPGs like **Persona 5 Tactica**, showcases the franchise's versatility and enduring appeal. Each spin-off often explores the lore and characters from the mainline games in new and exciting ways, further enriching the **Persona** universe. Fans eagerly anticipate what comes next, especially with the recent confirmation of **Persona 6** and the rumored **Persona 4 Revival**, promising more adventures with unforgettable characters and stylish presentation.

## What's Next for Persona Fans

With **Persona 5: The Phantom X** slated for a 2025 release and **Persona 6** officially announced, the future of the series looks incredibly bright. Atlus continues to expand the **Persona** universe, ensuring that players will have plenty of new stories and challenges to look forward to on their preferred platforms.

tr.title: Persona Serisi: Her Oyun ve Spin-Off Yeni Girişimciler için Sıralı
tr.summary: Sevgi duyulan Persona RPG serisi yeni açıklamalarla genişleyerek yeni girişimciler için nerede başlamak gerektiğini düşünmeye başladı. Shin Megami Tensei kökenlerinden medya imparatorluğuna, her başlıktan her spin-offa kadar her şeyi açıklıyoruz.
tr.body:
Persona serisi, Shin Megami Tensei'nin bir spin-offu olarak başladı ve şimdi bir küresel fenomen haline geldi. Güzellikli JRPG savaşları ve derin sosyal simülasyonların benzersiz bir karışımını sunan franchise, anime, manga, sahne oyunları ve daha fazlasını kapsıyor. Son açıklamalar, Persona 4 Revival ve çok beklenen Persona 6'u içermektedir. Şimdi hem uzun zamandır hayranlar hem de yeni girişimciler için serinin kapsamlı kütüphanesini keşfetmek ideal bir zaman.
Persona serisinin, 1996'da Revelations: Persona ile başladığı, zamanla bir evren oluşturduğu görülmektedir. Oyuncular, kendi psikolojilerinin bir ifadesi olan Personalar ile gizli bir dünyaya dalıyorlar. Hikaye genellikle lise öğrencilerinin gündelik hayatlarını olağanüstü savaşlarla dengelemesi üzerinedir. Seri, çekici karakterler, karmaşık hikayeler ve ikonik soundtrackler ile tanınır, modern RPG'lerin temelini oluşturmaktadır.

## Persona Serisinin Yolculuğu

Persona serisi, toplam 21 oyun içerir, ana serideki girişimler, geliştirilmiş sürümler ve çeşitli spin-offlar. Oynanış sırasıyla bir konsantrasyon deneyimi sunsa da, yayın sırasıyla serinin gelişimi ve mekaniklerin evrimini anlamak için önerilir. Yeni girişimciler için Persona 5 Royal, modern sunum ve etkileyici hikayesi ile sıkça önerilirken, Persona 4 Golden, sevgili karakterleri ve atmosferi ile güçlü bir adaydır. Son olarak, Persona 3 Reload, Personayı tanımlayan oyunu deneyimlemek için harika bir fırsat sunmaktadır.

## Bir Sergi Ki Devam Eder

Persona serisinin, ritim oyunlarından Persona 4: Dancing All Night'e kadar taktik RPG'lerden Persona 5 Tactica'ya kadar, serinin çeşitliliği ve kalıcılığı gösteren bir dizi başlık bulunmaktadır. Her spin-off, ana serideki oyunlardan yeni ve ilginç yollarla hikaye ve karakterleri keşfeder, Persona evrenini zenginleştirir. Hayranlar, özellikle Persona 6'ın resmi açıklaması ve Persona 4 Revival'ın önümüzdeki günlerde geleceği ile heyecan duyuyor.

## Persona Hayranları İçin Gelecek

Persona 5: The Phantom X'in 2025 yılında piyasaya sürülmesi ve Persona 6'ın resmi açıklaması ile seri için geleceğin parlak görünüyor. Atlus, oyuncuların yeni hikayeler ve meydan okumalarla yüzleşmelerini sağlayacak şekilde Persona evrenini genişletmeye devam ediyor.

es.title: La Serie Persona: Todos los Juegos y Spin-Off en Orden para Nuevos Jugadores
es.summary: La serie de rol de acción en profundidad Persona, que comenzó como una rama de Shin Megami Tensei, se ha convertido en un fenómeno global. Con anuncios recientes que sugieren Persona 4 Revival y la esperada Persona 6, ahora es el momento perfecto para que tanto fanáticos de larga data como nuevos jugadores naveguen por la extensa biblioteca de la serie.
es.body:
La serie Persona, que comenzó como una rama de Shin Megami Tensei, ha florecido en un fenómeno global. Su mezcla única de combate de rol de acción estilo japonés y simulación social profunda ha cautivado a millones, abarcando anime, manga, obras de teatro y más. Con anuncios recientes que sugieren Persona 4 Revival y la esperada Persona 6, ahora es el momento perfecto para que tanto fanáticos de larga data como nuevos jugadores naveguen por la extensa biblioteca de la serie.

## El Viaje de Persona

La serie Persona cuenta con un total de 21 juegos, incluyendo entradas principales, versiones mejoradas y varios spin-off. Si bien jugar en orden cronológico ofrece una experiencia narrativa cohesiva, el orden de lanzamiento se recomienda para comprender el desarrollo de la serie y cómo evolucionaron las mecánicas. Para aquellos que buscan unirse, Persona 5 Royal se cita con frecuencia como un punto de entrada excelente debido a su presentación moderna y su historia atractiva, aunque Persona 4 Golden también sigue siendo un contendiente fuerte por sus personajes queridos y su atmósfera.

## Una Franchise que Sigue Dando

El volumen considerable de títulos de Persona, desde juegos de ritmo como Persona 4: Dancing All Night hasta RPG tácticos como Persona 5 Tactica, muestra la versatilidad y el atractivo duradero de la franquicia. Cada spin-off a menudo explora la mitología y los personajes de los juegos principales de nuevas y emocionantes maneras, enriqueciendo aún más el universo de Persona. Los fans ansían saber qué viene a continuación, especialmente con la confirmación reciente de Persona 6 y el rumor de Persona 4 Revival, prometiendo más aventuras con personajes inolvidables y presentación elegante.

## Próximos Pasos para los Fans de Persona

Con Persona 5: The Phantom X programado para su lanzamiento en 2025 y Persona 6 anunciada oficialmente, el futuro de la serie parece radiante. Atlus sigue expandiendo el universo de Persona, asegurando que los jugadores tendrán muchas nuevas historias y desafíos para esperar en sus plataformas preferidas.

content_raw: Beginning its life as a Shin Megami Tensei spin-off, the Persona series has quickly launched into something entirely of its own and become one of the biggest names in modern RPGs. From multiple major sequels and remakes to anime adaptations and even stage plays, Persona is a multimedia sensation, and its popularity doesn’t seem to be slowing down anytime soon. With the official announcement of both Persona 4 Revival and Persona 6 , new players are probably wondering where’s the best place to start. Below, we’ll give you a full rundown of every game and spin-off, including the best entry point for newcomers and both the chronological and release order of the series. Jump to : How to play in order How to play by release date Upcoming releases How Many Persona Games Are There? In total, there are currently 21 Persona games . Several of these are expanded versions of the mainline entries in the series, whether that’s in the form of re-releases featuring new story content or remakes. While we won’t include direct ports or remasters, we’ll make sure to note every alternate version of each game when listing them below. Every Persona Game and Spin-Off in Release Order Revelations: Persona (1996) Persona 2: Innocent Sin (1999) Persona 2: Eternal Punishment (2000) Persona 3 (2006) Persona 3 FES (2007) Persona 4 (2008) Persona 3 Portable (2009) Persona 4 Arena (2012) Persona 4 Golden (2012) Persona 4 Arena Ultimax (2013) Persona Q: Shadow of the Labyrinth (2014) Persona 4: Dancing All Night (2015) Persona 5 (2016) Persona 3: Dancing in the Moonlight (2018) Persona 5: Dancing in the Starlight (2018) Persona Q2: New Cinema Labyrinth (2018) Persona 5 Royal (2019) Persona 5 Strikers (2020) Persona 5 Tactica (2023) Persona 3 Reload (2024) Persona 5: The Phantom X (2025) Which Persona Game Should You Play First? If you're looking for the perfect place to start, you can’t really go wrong jumping into Persona 3 Reload, Persona 4 Golden, or Persona 5 Royal. They’re the latest versions of the third, fourth and fifth mainline entries in the series, and, aside from Persona 3 Reload missing Nintendo Switch, they’re all available on PC and every major console. For those concerned about skipping the story by jumping into later entries in the series, you won’t miss anything by going straight to Persona 3, 4, or 5. Each game tells an entirely new story with original characters that’s largely disconnected from its predecessors, so they’re great launching points for those coming in fresh. To narrow your choices down, I'd recommend taking a look at some gameplay videos and some of the social links across each of the games to see what "stands out" to you.
